description: Dispatch prompt templates for the Overseer's 12-phase lifecycle engine. Each template defines how the 7 dispatch fields (DISPATCH TO, ACTION, ARTIFACT, DOMAIN|SCOPE|MODE, KDS, RETURN, ACCEPTANCE) are generated for a given mode. Slots marked {{variable}} are filled at generation time by the template engine from KD reader data and session context.

preflight.acceptance_pattern: Git workspace is clean, working branch exists, and any dirty state is stashed or committed

explore.acceptance_pattern: Exploration KD exists at knowledge/exploration-{{name}}-{{date}}.md covering {{objective}} with component map, architecture overview, and identified risks

investigate.acceptance_pattern: ANALYSIS KD exists at knowledge/analysis-{{name}}-{{date}}.md with findings, root cause analysis, severity classification, and actionable recommendations

align.acceptance_pattern: SPEC KD exists at knowledge/spec-{{name}}-{{date}}.md with numbered requirements, interface contracts, and verifiable acceptance criteria traceable to {{intent_kd}}

decompose.acceptance_pattern: PLAN KD exists at knowledge/plan-{{name}}-{{date}}.md with dependency graph, milestones, and every acceptance criterion from knowledge/spec-{{name}}-{{date}}.md mapped to a task

swarm.acceptance_pattern: All plan tasks from knowledge/plan-{{name}}-{{date}}.md are implemented, verification gates pass, and implementation summary KD exists at knowledge/impl-{{name}}-{{date}}.md

verify.acceptance_pattern: REVIEW KD or AUDIT KD exists at knowledge/review-{{name}}-{{date}}.md with PASS/FAIL verdict, traceability matrix, and evidence of verification against knowledge/spec-{{name}}-{{date}}.md

extract.acceptance_pattern: COMPOSED KDs exist consolidating session knowledge, stale KDs are marked superseded, and cross-references are updated

evolve.acceptance_pattern: PROCESS KD exists at knowledge/process-{{name}}-{{date}}.md with friction classification, severity rubric, and fix recommendations for improving the development process

commit.acceptance_pattern: Git workspace is clean, all changes are committed with semantic messages, and branch is pushed to remote

checkpoint.acceptance_pattern: Git workspace is clean and branch is ready for the next lifecycle step

report.acceptance_pattern: REPORT KD exists at knowledge/report-{{name}}-{{date}}.md summarizing all session findings, outcomes, and process friction
